title: Times Now reports Jantar Mantar trespassing case transferred to Crime Branch
excerpt: A Times Now headline reports the transfer of a trespassing case against Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content:
According to a Times Now headline, a Jantar Mantar trespassing case against Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka has been transferred to the Crime Branch.

The supplied metadata does not identify the date of the transfer or provide further case details. The reported allegations and transfer require human verification before publication.
